description: Get full side-by-side dealer price quotes, shipping policies, payment basis, and in-stock status for a specific bullion product by slug or product ID. Call this immediately after search_bullion_catalog, using the slug from a search result, when the buyer needs the FULL dealer-by-dealer breakdown (search results already include the top-3 delivered offers for a quick answer). Every offer carries provenance (observedAt, verificationMethod, freshnessSeconds) and a labeled delivered-price composition; a price is shown only when its offer was verified within the last 24 hours, and out-of-stock offers carry no price.

slugOrId.description: Product slug (e.g., '1-oz-american-gold-eagle-coin-bu') or canonical product ID.
